text: [hyped] Two beavers. Same job. Same seven thousand dollars a year into a TFSA.
[cheerful, proud] I started at twenty-five, bud!
[explaining] His cousin waited until thirty-five. Both invest until sixty-five, earning seven percent a year.
[amazed] Bernie puts in two hundred eighty thousand, and ends up with about one point four million dollars.
[serious] His cousin? About six hundred sixty thousand. Less than half. Just from waiting ten years.
[wise, chill] Ya can’t build a dam in the last week of summer, eh.
[quick] Seven percent isn’t guaranteed. But time is the real cheat code.
[excited, friendly] Want the full video? Watch it on YouTube! The link is in the description and in my bio!
